**Why:**
- **The cap is 15%.** The Acme NS-500 Strategic Account Exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) sets the maximum discount at 15% of list price. It runs from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31, so it covers 2026-09-23. David Morgan approved it on 2025-03-20. It replaced the earlier EXC-ACME-NS500-10, and it applies only to the NS-500 Industrial Controller.
- **The contract basis matches that cap.** DR-9001 cites "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement." That agreement also runs 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31.

- **The exception doesn't approve anything by itself.** It makes Acme eligible but says it does not grant approval authority. Even the 15% still needs sign-off and recorded approval evidence under the Northstar Pricing Policy 2026, which is in effect for all of 2026.

**What I couldn't confirm:** The 2026 policy says some discounts need VP Sales or Chief Revenue Officer approval, but the knowledge base doesn't hold the percentage thresholds. So I can't say whether either could approve going above the 15% exception, or who has to sign off on the 15%. As recorded, though, 18% is above what Acme is eligible for.

**Next step:** Keep DR-9001 at 15% and get it approved by the right person under the 2026 policy. Going higher would most likely need a new or amended exception.
